prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Spacecraft Operations Team:contingencies,safety-triage;Bluebell concurrence before uplink;Pass Replay Packet verifies archived-downlink reconstruction;integrated day-in-life rehearsal includes preparation,commanding,surveillance,anomaly,recovery. Command Validation Gateway(Osprey):independent command/burn/mode/baseline/provenance/security validation;rejects routine requests lacking approved authorization,validation result,operator acknowledgment. Telemetry Ingest Service:state→command-checks;validated frames/contact/flow/gaps→operations/engineering/processing;immutable raw staging. Readiness review board:open launch/commissioning actions require

New part:
S244: Operational key performance indicators include contact success rate, telemetry completeness, command validation timeliness, product latency, product quality disposition time, archive availability, help desk responsiveness, and unresolved anomaly age.
S245: Each key performance indicator has an assigned data source, sampling interval, review owner, threshold, and corrective action trigger so that routine reporting does not depend on informal judgment.
S246: The primary monthly service review compares actual performance against the accepted baseline and records trend explanations for any measure that moves outside the watch band.
S247: The Primary Processing Cluster and Backup Processing Cluster are baselined with approved software versions, processing configurations, capacity reservations, monitoring checks, and rollback instructions before handover.
S248: Configuration baselines for ground software, operational procedures, interface control data, account roles, and monitoring rules are frozen at readiness review entry and changed only through approved change control.
S249: Handover to routine mission service is authorized when acceptance evidence is complete, rehearsals meet their objectives, open risks are acknowledged by accountable owners, and support teams confirm on-call coverage.
S250: After handover, the first operational reporting cycle is treated as a stabilization period in which deviations are reviewed daily and permanent process changes are deferred until sufficient evidence is available.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
